authorship: Curated senior-designer-style reference cases for deterministic regression testing

finding.observation: The contact form uses the generic label Submit instead of describing the outcome.
finding.consequence: Visitors cannot tell whether the action sends an enquiry or starts another step.
finding.recommendation: Rename the button to Send project enquiry and show a confirmation after submission.
finding.evidence: The captured contact page shows a button labelled Submit.

finding.observation: Invalid fields use a red border but do not display field-level error text.
finding.consequence: Shoppers may not know what to correct before they can place the order.
finding.recommendation: Add a specific text error beside each invalid field and move focus to the first error.
finding.evidence: The captured validation state shows red borders with no adjacent error copy.

finding.observation: The settings screen remains visually unchanged after Save changes is selected.
finding.consequence: Users cannot confirm whether their settings were stored and may submit repeatedly.
finding.recommendation: Show a persistent success message and disable the button while the save request is running.
finding.evidence: The captured post-click state contains no success message, progress state, or changed button label.
